author: Luna
citation: Despite the hectic evening, the sounds of waves crashing against the shore soothed my weary soul to sleep. ... I stayed in Lot 11-B, which allowed overnight parking.
location: Lot 11-B, Oceanside Harbor overnight parking lot, near Oceanside Beach/Harbor, California, USA
provenance: First-person vanlife blog post by Luna on Luna in Orbit, September 2024, recounting van camping overnight in the paid parking lot at Oceanside Harbor after struggling to find other spots off the I-5.

author: Steve & Audra
citation: so i think we found a spot for the night ... we're looking forward to having some dinner now and settling in for the night. ... all right guys we're settled into bed here we're going to call it a night. ... it was a rough night when people finally quieted down and then all of a sudden palm fronds were dropping and trash was rolling across the parking lot
location: Overnight parking spot next to the beach in North Beach, Miami Beach area, Florida, USA
provenance: Personal vanlife vlog by Steve & Audra, March 2022, describing boondocking overnight in a parking lot right next to the beach in the Miami North Beach area, found via iOverlander, with a rough night due to noise and unexpected film production.

author: DangGoodLife (couple)
citation: Our vanlife parking spot is the main reason we stayed in Playa Zipolite for so long! ... A FREE parking spot that is ~100 feet from the ocean waves. Wow! Open your doors wide, let the breeze flow through, hear the waves crashing
location: Free community beachfront parking/boondocking area on the sand, Playa Zipolite, Oaxaca, Mexico
provenance: Personal overland vanlife account by the DangGoodLife couple, describing spending nearly a month boondocking in the free sandy parking area ~100 feet from the waves at Playa Zipolite.
